events.title: Berkeley in the '60s: Free Speech Movement Walking Tour
events.why: A 1-mile paved walk visiting key Free Speech Movement sites and 1960s protest locations, led by Rodney Paul. Connects Berkeley's countercultural history to the physical campus landscape.

events.title: West Oakland Tape Music Festival
events.why: Fixed-media works projected live over a 16-channel Meyer Sound System in complete darkness, featuring Varèse's Poème Électronique and a rare Pauline Oliveros piece alongside modern acousmatic composers.

events.price_note: Tickets required; see Gray Area box office
events.title: SF Chronicle presents: San Francisco Time Machine with Peter Hartlaub
events.why: An evening of Chronicle archive photos and stories with former Mayor Art Agnos and Muni archivist Jeremy Menzies, diving into 1970s-80s SF history inside the Gray Area Grand Theater.

events.price_note: Suggested donation $15; pay what you want
events.title: BYOB (Bring Your Own Beamer) Pop-Up Projector Show
events.why: Rafaël Rozendaal's net-art-originated concept: artists bring their own projectors and take over Gray Area with ephemeral generative visuals, DIY hardware contraptions, and immersive light. Peak art-tech community energy.

events.title: Merope w/ Shahzad Ismaily + David Wesley Golightly
events.why: Lithuanian ambient folk via kanklės and electronics meets Oakland synth composer Golightly's debut solo piano album, transmuting analog synthesis to acoustic piano. Two sets of deep-listening experimental music.

events.title: Black August Film Screening: The Strike
events.why: Documentary on the Pelican Bay hunger strike paired with panel, community dinner, healing sessions, letter writing, and live performance. A full community ritual around prison resistance and Black August traditions.

events.price_note: Tickets via Gray Area box office; two performances at 3pm and 6:30pm
events.title: Ambrose Trataris: Daisy-Chain Star-Connection
events.why: World premiere of a hybrid VR performance blending contemporary dance, drag artistry, 3D world design, and motion capture. Queer worldbuilding in mixed reality, with go-go dancers mirrored by holographic avatars. Cyberculture made flesh.

events.title: Xicana Moratorium Block Party
events.why: Annual community block party commemorating the 1970 Chicano Moratorium with live music, speakers, poets, screen printing, face painting, food vendors, and local organizing groups. Deep East Oakland resistance culture.

events.title: DOMI + Kaitlin McSweeney + K. Francis Messer / Ken Ueno + Matt Ingalls
events.why: An experimental trio of prepared drums, scrap metal, cello, and salvaged objects meets Ken Ueno's overtone singing and Matt Ingalls' multiphonic clarinet. Deep-listening improvisation in an intimate West Oakland studio.

events.price_note: $12 per program; members $10; festival passes available
events.title: CROSSROADS 2026: San Francisco Cinematheque Experimental Film Festival
events.why: 49 works by 52 artists across 22 countries in 8 curated programs, with JG Thirlwell live-scoring Harry Smith's occult classic Heaven and Earth Magic. The most expansive experimental cinema showcase in the US, now at Gray Area.

events.title: Heart Trio: William Parker, Hamid Drake, Cooper-Moore
events.why: Three free-jazz legends in a deeply improvisational setting. Parker's bass, Drake's percussion, and Cooper-Moore's handmade instruments converge for what promises to be a transcendent evening of creative music.

events.title: Michelle Lou / Stefan Maier + 100,000,000 Unread Messages
events.why: Lou and Maier present experimental sound works alongside the piece 100,000,000 Unread Messages, exploring the overwhelming texture of digital communication through sound art and performance.

events.price_note: $23 per night; $60 festival pass; member discounts
events.title: San Francisco Electronic Music Festival (SFEMF) 2026
events.why: Three nights at The Lab featuring Rrose, Moor Mother, Seth Cluett, Paul DeMarinis, Blevin Blectum, and others. The 25th anniversary of the Bay Area's premier artist-run electronic music festival.

events.price_note: See Berkeley Historical Society for details
events.title: Tank Houses in Northwest Berkeley: Walking Tour
events.why: A walk reconstructing the circa-1900 Berkeley urban landscape where windmill-topped water towers stood on nearly every block, pulling well water into elevated tanks. Forgotten infrastructure as media archaeology.
